metaTitle: Confidence With CoolSculpting - Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa

blocks.html: Many of us have those stubborn body areas when it comes to losing fat and keeping it off. Sometimes we need extra help when diet and exercise can’t cut it. That doesn’t mean you have to go under the knife (have surgery) to take care of those unwanted areas. There is a non-invasive procedure that Victory MedSpa offers called CoolSculpting. If you want to look and feel good without having to feel self-conscious about that one area that really bothers you, then consider calling Victory MedSpa and asking about a free CoolSculpting consultation.

CoolSculpting is the only FDA approved non-surgical fat reduction procedure that has been proven time and again to provide long lasting results. The treated fat cells are frozen, then gradually die off and your body naturally excretes them over time. As your body works to get rid of these fat cells that were previously frozen, you will start to see a more sculpted body and a reduction in the fat that was in the area you were most concerned about.

blocks.text: Will My Skin Freeze During the Procedure?

blocks.html: No, the CoolSculpting device is FDA approved to target the fat cells only. The surrounding tissue will get cold but will not be affected at all. There might be some light bruising and redness after the procedure in the treated area, but this is often minimal and goes away.

blocks.text: Does Victory MedSpa Offer Free CoolSculpting Consultations?

blocks.html: Yes, when you come in for a free consultation, we will discuss your ultimate goals, explain the process, and complete a full body assessment. We will customize your treatment plan based on your specific body needs.

blocks.text: What Areas of the Body Can Be Treated?

blocks.html: CoolSculpting can target all areas of the body including abdomen, double chin, inner and outer thighs, back fat, underarm fat, banana roll area (under the butt), and muffin top.
If you are curious about before and after pictures, ask our talented aestheticians and they will be happy to show you results from real patients.
Call Victory MedSpa today and ask about any specials or promotions we have going on and book your free consultation!
